newsitem.title: USA: Fore Systems target of class action.
newsitem.headline: Fore Systems target of class action.

text.p: A class action complaint was filed against FORE Systems Inc charging the company and certain officers with misrepresentations that inflated the company's stock, plaintiff's attorneys said Friday.
The complaint was filed in U.S. District Court for the Western District of Pennsylvania on behalf of buyers of Fore Systems shares from October 17, 1996 to April 1, 1997.

The law firms of Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP and Schiffrin & Craig Ltd said in a statement Friday that insiders at Fore Systems allegedly sold shares at prices as high as $42.27 a share before the company's stock dropped to $13.06 a share.
A call to Fore Systems offices in Pittsburgh Friday evening was not immediately returned.
